methodology_lesson_17_new.description: §68 ran a 3-problem smoke pre-fix with R1+R2 only and observed 0/3 flip. Conclusion at the time: 'failures are Class B (sampling/quantization)'. The TRUE failure class was Class C (harness-RC3) — invisible because R1+R2 doesn't touch the format!() at line 400. Lesson: a 0/N flip RATE in a smoke does NOT prove the failure class — it only proves the candidate fix doesn't move the needle. The class must be identified via diagnostic instrumentation (APR_EVAL_DEBUG=1), not inferred from a flip rate.
